_comment: PERSISTENT LEAGUE MEMORY for JAAFFL. Any coding or agent work MUST read this file (and CLAUDE.md) BEFORE beginning, to avoid loss of critical configuration. These settings are owner-provided and IMMUTABLE — never paraphrase, summarize, or change them without explicit owner approval.

draft_order.method: Decided in-person, then entered into CBS Sports system
draft_order.note: Do NOT assume a simple snake order from team count alone. The actual order is decided in person and entered into CBS; read the real order from the CBS draft room.

league.scoring_note: Standard = non-PPR (0 points per reception). Exact per-category values follow CBS 'Standard' defaults; confirm precise yardage/TD/turnover and K/DST values from the league's CBS scoring settings page before relying on them for point projections.

roster_derived_facts.starters_breakdown: QB 1 + RB 1 + WR 3 + WR/RB flex 1 + TE 1 + K 1 + DST 1 = 9
roster_derived_facts.picks_equal_rounds: 9 starters + 8 bench = 17 = draft_rounds; every pick fills a roster slot.
strategic_notes: WR-HEAVY roster: 3 mandatory WR starters PLUS a WR/RB-only flex (no TE eligibility in flex). Only 1 RB is mandatory to start.
Standard (non-PPR) scoring de-emphasizes high-volume/possession receivers relative to PPR, but the 3WR + WR/RB-flex requirement raises league-wide WR demand regardless.
K and DST each occupy exactly 1 starting slot; conventional strategy drafts them last (final 1-2 rounds).
Deep bench (8) over 17 rounds allows handcuffs, upside stashes, and positional insurance.

hard_constraints_verbatim: Draft Order: Decided in-person, then entered into CBS Sports system
Roster Slots per Team: QB = 1, RB = 1, WR = 3, WR/RB = 1, TE = 1, K = 1, DST = 1, Bench = 8
agent_usage_contract: Before any draft-system implementation, an agent must (1) load this file, (2) treat every value in 'league' and 'hard_constraints_verbatim' as fixed input, (3) compute replacement/VOR baselines against THIS roster (not generic defaults), and (4) surface — not silently change — any apparent conflict with these settings.
